patterns.note: A flexible, responsive image grid displays project work, adapting column count and image aspect ratios to fill the available space in a dynamic, gallery-like arrangement.
All UI text, including navigation and project labels, uses a consistent small, uppercase sans-serif typeface, creating a flat and understated typographic hierarchy that prioritizes imagery.
The user interface employs a stark monochromatic palette of light gray backgrounds and dark text, allowing the diverse colors and textures within the project images to be the sole visual focus.

A fixed header remains persistently visible at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, with the main content grid scrolling smoothly underneath it without any additional scroll-triggered animations.

technique_notes: The site features a fixed header that remains visible at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls, allowing the main content grid to scroll seamlessly beneath it.
A responsive, flexible grid layout displays project images, adapting column count and image sizing to available viewport width, creating a dynamic, gallery-like presentation.
The overall design relies on a minimalist aesthetic, using ample whitespace and a limited color palette for UI elements to direct attention entirely to the high-quality project photography.

design_tokens.type_scale: Flat and understated, with small uppercase sans-serif for navigation and even smaller sans-serif for project labels, emphasizing imagery over text hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, applied to images and overall layout elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and deliberate, with generous padding around the main content grid and between grid items, creating a gallery-like feel.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its extreme minimalism and almost brutalist approach to a portfolio. It strips away nearly all decorative UI, presenting high-quality project imagery in a flexible, monochromatic grid that feels more like an art gallery or a curated catalog than a typical website, making the work itself the absolute focal point.
